subject: Vitamin D and the aging brain: a signal worth decoding
script: From Agewell Brief: Vitamin D and the aging brain: a signal worth decoding. New Emory research links higher vitamin D intake to better cognition in those at dementia risk. Here's what the physics of cellular signaling suggests—and what it doesn't prove. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
